## Run 6 — SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

Raw first: clean, deep SdH from ~2 T, R(0) ≈ 52 Ω, R_max ≈ 530 Ω (11 % of the 50 µV full scale — no clipping; `sdh_onset` clip check agrees). **Tone set (FFT 1–10 T, δF ≈ 1.1 T):** a strong light tone at **7.1 T** and heavy-tone content at **22.2 T** and **29.5 T** (SNR 87–101), plus 14.1 T ≈ 2×7.1 (harmonic). Against F_L = 33.1 T (run-5 cal, geometry-prior scale) and the model table (`tetralayer_fs_count`: ABAB pair 7.31/25.78 T at +3.2×10¹²; ABCA singleton 33.1 T): the natural grouping is an **ABAB-template pair (7.1, 22.2) with sum 29.3 ≈ the 29.5 T tone** — a symmetry-allowed magnetic-breakdown/sum orbit sitting at the true F_L — putting the global density scale at ≈ 0.89 (inside the ~0.8–1.2 lever-arm band); partition 0.24/0.76 vs model 0.22/0.78. The alias reading (22.2 = 3×7.1, 29.5 = 4×7.1, a comb) is Luttinger-inconsistent (a lone 7.1 T pocket carries ~¼ of the density) and the harmonic offsets (0.9–1.1 T vs exact k×7.1) are marginal at this δF — **the fan's n-dependence decides** (a harmonic tracks k·f exactly; a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve). **Onset: censored at the 0.3 T record edge** — and the sub-1 T leg was sampled at 50 mT, under-Nyquist for a 7.1 T tone (period 69 mT at 0.7 T), so the sub-1 T "content" is not trustworthy; the true onset needs the low-field extension before the fan is priced (`landau-fan` step 1, censored branch). Consistent-with ABAB at this single density; not yet a call.

"""sdh-spot-check read on run 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0->10 T uniform-B):
raw Rxx(B), background-subtracted dRxx, sdh_onset tone track, FFT in 1/B vs F_L."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

rid, n_spot = 6, +3.2e12  # cm^-2
r6 = open_run(Path(file_path) / str(rid))
print(summarize_run(r6))
B6 = r6.col("magnet_field")
I6 = r6.col("sr0_X") / (-1e6)                 # measured drain current, A
R6 = np.abs(r6.col("sr1_X") / I6)             # sr1 gain 1 (device card)
o6 = np.argsort(B6); B6, R6, I6 = B6[o6], R6[o6], I6[o6]
FL6 = luttinger_frequency(abs(n_spot) * 1e4)  # cm^-2 -> m^-2
print(f"I_meas ~ {np.median(np.abs(I6))*1e9:.2f} nA; R(B<0.2 T) = {np.median(R6[B6 < 0.2]):.0f} Ohm, "
      f"R_max = {R6.max():.0f} Ohm ({R6.max()/(50e-6/np.median(np.abs(I6))):.0%} of the 50 uV FS); F_L = {FL6:.1f} T")

# raw FIRST
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(10, 10))
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=0.6)
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw: Rxx(B) at n = +3.2e12, D = 0 (sr1/sr0, gain-divided)")

# onset / tone track (r_full_scale flags soft clipping)
on6 = sdh_onset(R6, B6, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I6)))
print(on6.summary())

# background-subtracted (deg-5 in B, B >= 1 T where the grid is 10 mT)
m = B6 >= 1.0
dR6 = R6[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B6[m], R6[m], 5), B6[m])
ax[1].plot(B6[m], dR6, lw=0.6)
ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm)", title="MR background removed (deg 5 in B), 1-10 T")

# FFT in 1/B on the 10 mT record (cutoff at 1 T: the 50 mT sub-1 T grid under-samples a 7 T tone)
freqs6, spec6 = sdh_fft(R6[m][:, None], B6[m], b_range=(1.0, 10.0), nfft=4096)
ax[2].plot(freqs6, spec6[0], lw=0.8)
for f, c, lbl in ((FL6, "r", f"F_L = {FL6:.1f} T"), (25.78, "g", "ABAB heavy 25.8 T [model]"),
                  (7.31, "g", "ABAB light 7.3 T [model]")):
    ax[2].axvline(f, color=c, ls="--", lw=1, label=lbl)
ax[2].set(xlim=(0, 55), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="|FFT| (dB-ish)", title="FFT in 1/B, window 1-10 T")
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout()

## Run 7 — SdH spot check, hole side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = −1.2×10¹², D = 0, B 10 → 0.3 T (ride-down)

Raw first: oscillations present, onset **0.71 T** (measured, not censored — the 20 mT grid Nyquists a 6.6 T tone down to ~0.5 T), R_max ≈ 590 Ω, no clipping. Tone set vs F_L = 12.4 T: a busy, mutually-harmonic-entangled cluster (6.6, 4.7, 8.5, 9.4, 12.3, 14.8 T…) — exactly the recipe's stated **near-CNP hole exception regime** (the D = 0 line reaches only n = −1.27×10¹² on this side, TG-limited; pair close and balanced, beat-like). 12.3 T ≈ F_L is present, and 6.6 + 4.7 = 11.3 ≈ 0.91·F_L echoes run 6's global scale ≈ 0.89, but the set under-determines the template at this density and δF. **Take:** the hole side is resolvability-limited by the gate window, not by the device — it confirms SdH on both carrier signs and an onset ≈ 0.7 T at low |n|. **The fan goes on the electron side** (run 6: tones well-separated, F_L 33 T, n reaches 3.2×10¹²), per the investigation's no-side-prior → cleaner-side rule.

## HERA — Step 3c: low-field onset extension, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹², B 0.05 → 1.6 T

> **05:27** · sdh-spot-check low-field extension: electron spot n=+3.2e12 D=0, B 0.05-1.6 T (4 mT to 0.6 T, 10 mT above), 239 pts, sr1 50 uV; pins fan B\_lo · **ETA ~05:57** (≈30 min)

Run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is **censored at its 0.3 T record edge**, and the sub-1 T leg was 50 mT-sampled — under-Nyquist for a 7.1 T tone (period 69 mT at 0.7 T), so the electron-side onset is unmeasured. `landau-fan` step 1 (censored branch) requires pinning it before pricing the fan: **B_lo = measured onset**, and each 0.25 T of unnecessary low-field reach costs the fan tens of rows. Grid: 0.05 → 0.6 T at **4 mT** (tracks a 7.1 T tone down to ~0.24 T; hole-side onset was 0.71 T, so this bottoms out below any plausible electron onset), then 0.6 → 1.6 T at **10 mT** (run-6 grid, overlap cross-check on the light tone). Same spot, sensitivity, τ as run 6 (max R here was 530 Ω ≪ 5 kΩ FS). Preconditions: B ≈ 0 (handoff state), T base, gates ramp to spot. Ends at 1.6 T — the fan then starts near its own B_lo, no re-traverse. Checkpoint: first rows (signal + leakage); read = `sdh_onset` on the landed record.

# === Low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`): electron spot n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.05 -> 1.6 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 cal
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V (run-6 spot)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (expect ~0: handoff state), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: 4 mT to 0.6 T (Nyquist for a 7.1 T tone down to ~0.24 T), 10 mT to 1.6 T (run-6 grid overlap) ---
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack([np.arange(0.05, 0.6001, 0.004), np.arange(0.61, 1.6001, 0.01)]), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # unchanged from runs 6/7
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s "
      f"(settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field extension, electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.05 -> 1.6 T (4 mT to 0.6, 10 mT above), sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension, electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.05 -> 1.6 T (4 mT below 0.6 T, 10 mT above); '
              f'pins B_lo for the landau fan (run 6 onset censored at 0.3 T edge); cal run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.089e12, D_offset -0.013')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.6 T -- the fan starts near here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
